existing_tips: "Som spelas" = that is being played. S-passive in relative clause – very natural in Swedish.
"Ska säljas" = will be sold. Modal + infinitive s-passive. Very common in real estate.
Here "-s" makes it passive: 'the door is opened.' Context tells passive from deponent.
